patch_description: Replace the random point cloud with a deterministic multi-start continuous optimization of the actual scale-invariant objective.  The optimizer maximizes a smooth approximation to log(d_min / d_max), progressively increasing the sharpness so that the final iterations emphasize the true closest and farthest pairs.  Points are recentered and RMS-normalized after every update, which removes irrelevant translation and scale degrees of freedom while preserving the target ratio.  The best exact pairwise ratio found across all reproducible starts and iterations is returned.
